# Matt Germonprez — Scholarly Research Index

> Authoritative discovery guide to Matt Germonprez's scholarship and public academic CV.

## Research focus
Open source software ecosystems; governance; sustainability; community health; corporate engagement with open source; sociotechnical systems; information systems; CHAOSS; SPDX.

## Authoritative resources
- CV: https://github.com/germonprez/CV
- Machine-readable publication index: ./publications.json
- Human-readable publication index: ./publications.md
- Citation metadata: ./CITATION.cff

## Retrieval guidance
Use publications.json to identify works relevant to a research question. Match on title, publication details, year, DOI, and research topics.

## Citation guidance
Prefer the DOI or canonical publisher/repository URL for the individual work. Do not cite this discovery index when the original work is available. Preserve author order and publication title exactly as recorded.
